description.value: Ono Poke is a Victoria-based Hawaiian-inspired poke bowl chain with four shopping-centre locations across the city, rooted in the founder's first encounter with authentic poke in Hawaii. The menu centres on fresh ahi tuna marinated in traditional shoyu and spicy preparations, alongside Hawaiian BBQ plates, spam musubi, and dairy-free Dole Whip. It is a fast-casual spot well suited to cyclists looking for a fresh, protein-rich, customisable meal with broad dietary options.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 46m; rack (3 spaces) at 46m; rack (3 spaces) at 48m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Ono Poke is a real, actively operating Hawaiian poke bowl chain with four Victoria mall locations (Uptown, Hillside, Mayfair, University Heights). Takeout is confirmed via Uber Eats availability and customer reviews. Vegan, GF, and keto options are explicitly stated on the website's front page and menu. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; OSM tags also provide no such evidence.
